BidderCategory.title: BidderCategory
BidderCategory.description: Classification of the bidding entity as declared in the bid.

contract_value_lakh.title: Contract Value Lakh
contract_value_lakh.description: Contract value in Indian Rupees lakh.

name.title: Name
name.description: Legal name of the bidding entity.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the bidder.

land_border_registered.title: Land Border Registered
land_border_registered.description: Whether the bidder is registered with the competent authority for land-border countries (MC-07).

incorporation_date.title: Incorporation Date
incorporation_date.description: Date of incorporation / registration. Must not be in the future.

startup_certificate_number.title: Startup Certificate Number
startup_certificate_number.description: DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate number. System does not decide startup recognition.

annual_turnover_lakh.title: Annual Turnover Lakh
annual_turnover_lakh.description: Annual turnover in INR lakh for the last three financial years (oldest first: FY-3, FY-2, FY-1).

years_experience.title: Years Experience
years_experience.description: Total years of relevant service experience.

similar_services.title: Similar Services
similar_services.description: List of prior similar service contracts (for MC-03 / MC-04).

manpower_payroll_percent.title: Manpower Payroll Percent
manpower_payroll_percent.description: Percentage of total manpower on payroll for at least one year (MC-05).

emd_submitted.title: Emd Submitted
emd_submitted.description: Whether Earnest Money Deposit has been submitted.

emd_amount_inr.title: Emd Amount Inr
emd_amount_inr.description: EMD amount in INR as submitted (MC-01 threshold: 117,600).

emd_exemption_claimed.title: Emd Exemption Claimed
emd_exemption_claimed.description: Whether the bidder has claimed EMD exemption.

office_in_consignee_state.title: Office In Consignee State
office_in_consignee_state.description: Whether the bidder has a service office in the consignee's state (MC-08).

documents_submitted.title: Documents Submitted
documents_submitted.description: List of document identifiers / names submitted with the bid (MC-06).

bid_ref.title: Bid Ref
bid_ref.description: Unique bid reference identifier assigned by the procuring entity.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text notes. GUARDRAIL SCANNING REQUIRED before processing.
